attributes.board_name: South Dakota State Board of Dentistry

rules.notes: Five-year CE cycle; license renewed annually by July 1 ($95 + $20 CE fee per year). 5 h dental radiography required (max 20 h). Current CPR card required. Limits per cycle: home study 30 h, practice management 10 h, nutrition 15 h, CPR 15 h.
rules.rule_quote: A dental hygienist shall complete at least 75 hours of board approved continuing education in each five-year licensure cycle.

topics.who: Current CPR card; max 15 CPR h per cycle
